items.finding: The live packet is aggregating a stale gating issue from superseded Alpha v1/v3. Alpha v1 blocked a complete score because valuation, governance, supply-chain and pricing-power inputs were missing. Alpha v4 explicitly supersedes Alpha v3, contains current SEC 10-Q and DEF 14A lineage, timestamped external valuation observations, numeric evidence for all 12 methodology components, numeric risk and Data Confidence, and a complete publishable scoreRecord. Alpha v4 itself has gatingIssues=[] in source-integrity and no live gating defect in company-underwriting.
items.gateImpact: The stale unresolved_gating_issue should not block ALAB after deterministic packet recompilation honors supersession/current evidence lineage.

items.finding: The gating unknowns in Alpha v1/v3 are no longer live gating unknowns. Alpha v4 supplies the previously missing valuation and governance evidence, assigns supplyChainResilience conservatively with uncertainty preserved, and supports pricingPower from filed gross-margin/mix evidence. Residual competitive-share, supplier-diversification and future product-conversion unknowns are explicitly retained as non-gating rather than silently erased.
items.gateImpact: The stale unresolved_gating_unknown should not block ALAB after deterministic packet recompilation; residual unknowns remain visible but non-gating.
